_help: One entry per listing site. Only name and listing_url are required. Use {page} in the URL if the site has numbered pages. item_link_re is optional: a regex for settlement page links, only needed if auto-detect picks the wrong links. Set enabled to false to pause a site. no_proof_url is optional: a page listing only no-proof settlements on that site. cards is optional, for sites that show each settlement as a card with a direct button to the claim site: {"link_text": "text on that button"}.
